response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(dp.disp_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(region_total, 0) AS region_share, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(overall_total, 0) AS overall_share FROM totals ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;
